identified_issues: Ambiguous sensor telemetry indistinguishable between benign transient thermal contraction and catastrophic drive shaft shear micro-crack
Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic necessary to disambiguate structural integrity is offline and unexecuted
Premature operational decision-making risking catastrophic failure upon valve opening under pressure or unnecessary teardown
evidence: Channel 1 measured value is +12.4 mV, exceeding the nominal band (0.0 mV ± 2.0 mV) and falling squarely within the +10 mV to +15 mV range common to both Mechanism A and Mechanism B.
Housing temperature sensors have not reached steady-state thermal equilibrium.
Channel 2 integrated ultrasonic pulse diagnostic is currently marked OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
recommended_action: Hold automated valve actuation. Maintain the valve in the closed position, await thermal equilibrium (approximately 90 seconds into fill) to monitor whether the bridge voltage normalizes, and activate Channel 2 to execute the ultrasonic pulse diagnostic verifying shaft structural integrity prior to any movement.
